arguments.sql: SELECT MIN(t.date) AS first_fraud_date, MAX(t.date) AS last_fraud_date FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) WHERE f.is_fraud = 1
arguments.explanation: Returns the earliest and latest timestamps among transactions labelled as fraud.
assumptions: Fraud means fraud_labels.is_fraud = 1; only labelled transactions are considered.
'First' and 'last' are by transaction date/time across the full data range 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
